subject: Next steps — 30m demo availability (BlueHarbor AI)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Stone <alex.stone@blueharbor.ai>, Priya Singh <psingh@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — 30m demo availability (BlueHarbor AI)

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet your team on today's discovery — thanks for walking through the use cases and the latency/cost constraints around embedding-based retrieval. Quick recap and a practical next step to keep momentum:

- Recap: You're evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-query token cost and improve tail latency for high-concurrency retrieval queries. Key stakeholders: Carlos (ML lead), product manager (Priya), and an infra/ops reviewer.
- Ask: Schedule a focused 30-minute product demo + short Q&A where we show the latency/cost dashboard, routing/fallback behavior, and a short integration sketch for your retrieval pipeline.

I have three concise windows (PDT) next week — pick whichever works best for you:
1) Tue Jun 1, 09:30–10:00
2) Tue Jun 1, 14:00–14:30
3) Wed Jun 2, 11:00–11:30

Please tell us: which window you prefer, and confirm who from your side should join (Carlos, any infra/ops contact). We can tighten the agenda if you want the demo to skew technical. I've attached a short 1-page agenda and included a one-click calendar invite link below.

Attachments: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite?uuid=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0-0/deal/BH-2027-042

Thanks — happy to adjust if those times conflict.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Priyom — thanks for the follow-up and the clear options.

Quick note: Tue morning is tight for our ML team (we have an all-hands), but Tue 14:00 PT could work if Carlos is available. Wed 11:00 PT is likely the best for us. If it helps, we'd prefer an hour starting with a brief 30-minute demo focused on the routing/cache behavior and then a 30-minute optional deep dive with Carlos and our infra lead. If an hour is too heavy, we'll join for 30 minutes and then keep the deep dive separate.

Attaching Carlos here: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@blueharbor.ai> — he'll confirm availability, but his preference is Wed morning PT.

Hi Alex / Priya / Carlos,

Thanks for flagging scheduling constraints — happy to be flexible. We can do Wed Jun 2 at 11:00 PT as a 30-minute focused demo, and we'll schedule an optional follow-up deep dive with Carlos if you want to extend.

Proposed (confirmed):
- Wed Jun 2, 11:00–11:30 PT — 30-minute product demo + 10-minute buffer for quick Qs

Attendees from our side: Priyom (AE), Monica (solutions engineer), Grace O'Connor (infra/ops lead).

I've updated the attached agenda to call out the sections we'll prioritize:
- 0–5m: goals and acceptance criteria (we'll confirm yours live)
- 5–18m: live demo showing routing, KV cache behavior, and cost/latency dashboard
- 18–25m: brief integration sketch (embedding flow + prefix caching suggestions)
- 25–30m: next steps and follow-up request (deep dive with Carlos)

Attachments: Redwood-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (v2)
Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/invite?uuid=def456

If Wed 11:00 doesn't work for Carlos, let us know and we'll adjust. Also, if you want any specific queries or dataset examples to be prepared, send them over and Grace will bring the infra notes.

Best,

Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
